purpose: Read-only, evidence-backed placement of canonical repo contracts and replaceable cross-repo source snapshots on each personal workstation.

host_policy.default_profile_from: USERPROFILE on Windows; HOME on POSIX

artifact_catalog.notes: 97-record source registry export. Exact source URL is not a host-mounted path. Data may be a stale local snapshot even if hashed.

artifact_catalog.requires: PR #233 integration plus a proven current checkout
artifact_catalog.notes: Do not make a shared editable second master.
Prompt Kit P-number authority stays with TokenCorridor.

artifact_catalog.requires: PR #21 integration plus a proven current checkout

invariants: No creation, copying, moving, cleanup or overwrite in locator mode.
Source-of-truth repo files remain in exactly one normal local checkout per host and a remote Git owner.
Shared reference snapshots are replaceable copies, never promoted to original authority.
Host alias DTop/PTop is not actual machine attestation; preserve separate hostname evidence.
An existing file without matching sidecar hash and declared source remains unverified and protected.
A matching sidecar proves local integrity only, not freshness or a live Google Drive read.
Offline source retrieval is usable without Google login only after an explicit verified local copy exists.
Real path inventories and host receipts remain local/ignored; never commit or sync personal paths into public repositories.
Mixed-owner paths and symlink/reparse ancestors fail closed.
